claim: For every finite quiver \(Q=(Q_0,Q_1,s,t)\) and finite field \(k=\mathbb F_q\), let \(J\) be the arrow ideal and \(A=kQ/J^2\). Write \(m_{uv}=|\{\alpha\in Q_1:s(\alpha)=u,\ t(\alpha)=v\}|\), \(E=|Q_1|\), \(L=\sum_{v\in Q_0}m_{vv}\), and \(\Gamma_Q=\{\sigma\in\operatorname{Sym}(Q_0):m_{uv}=m_{\sigma(u)\sigma(v)}\text{ for all }u,v\}\). The map induced on \(A/J\) has image \(\Gamma_Q\), its kernel is isomorphic to \((J/(Z(A)\cap J),+)\rtimes\prod_{u,v\in Q_0}\operatorname{GL}_{m_{uv}}(k)\), and hence \(\left|\operatorname{Aut}_{k\text{-alg}}(A)\right|=q^{E-L}|\Gamma_Q|\prod_{u,v\in Q_0}|\operatorname{GL}_{m_{uv}}(\mathbb F_q)|\), with \(\operatorname{GL}_0(\mathbb F_q)\) trivial.

limits: Does not cover nonsplit semisimple quotients or arbitrary radical-square-zero algebras outside the stated quiver form.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Finite quivers over finite fields; only field-linear algebra automorphisms of the split quotient F_q Q/J^2.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: Symbolic proof plus six exhaustive F_2 cases; finite checks are corroborative only.

title: Automorphism Orders of Radical-Square-Zero Quiver Algebras
